# 🛡️ Threat Assessment Template

## System scope
Describe components, assets, deployment boundaries, and exclusions.

## Data flow and trust boundaries
Add a diagram showing entry points, processing, storage, and outputs.

## Threat identification
| Asset | Threat | Entry point | Impact | Existing control |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Risk rating
Define the likelihood/impact scale and explain each rating.

## Mitigation plan
| Threat ID | Mitigation | Owner | Due date | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Residual risk and approval
Document accepted risks, assumptions, review date, and approver. Do not claim a formal audit without evidence.
